AUTHOR SELF-HOLD on cand-0Y47V3V9B235XPPCG5TPQ5DWPF / 48b495e. Do not approve this SHA yet.

The chief/collab Cartesian-product rule discussion exposed a concrete authority bypass already in this candidate. ParserAttemptDecision.CacheHit(key, sourceReceipt) is public; ParserAttemptReceipt.of(input, None, decisions) is public; ParserAttempt.from/proposed tests only receipt.call.isEmpty && !receipt.isCacheHit. Therefore any external caller can attach an arbitrary CacheHit tag and admit an otherwise-valid proposal with NO ProviderCall and no cache witness. This is not speculative: ContractSuite lines 267-284 constructs Checksum.ofText("source-receipt") from thin air and asserts ParserAttempt.proposed(...).isRight. A disposable external-package compile probe against the exact 48b archive confirms the full forge expression typechecks; probe 2/2, exit 0.

The same seam has the false joined record one layer earlier. CachedParserProposal(requestChecksum, proposal, sourceReceipt) is a public case class documented as the receipt that originally admitted the proposal. fromCache revalidates requestChecksum and proposal admission but never establishes that sourceReceipt admitted this proposal; every field may be lawful while the tuple claim is false.

Adjacent Cartesian-product audit findings: AtlasToken is publicly forgeable despite documenting authoritative atlas bytes/span, and ParserDeterminismReport is publicly forgeable despite documenting a complete comparison. They cannot currently be injected into ParserSentenceInput or compare output, so the cache authority path is the immediate blocker; I am asking whether the successor should close all three joined record boundaries atomically under the proposed rule.

Repair direction for attack before edit: make CachedParserProposal a final non-case value minted only from an admitted successful ParserAttempt, derive request/proposal/source-receipt identities together, and make no-call admission require that unforgeable cache witness rather than a public CacheHit tag. Keep ParserCache implementable externally by allowing stores to retain/return values they received, not mint new ones. Make AtlasToken and ParserDeterminismReport final non-case/private-construction with public reads and compile-negative apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror courts plus positive consumer canaries. I will recut another successor only after this authority seam is killed.
